whenToUse: There are many tabs with short names, such as product categories.
Tabs are wider than the screen on mobile.
whenNotToUse: There are only three or four tabs (use ordinary tabs).
People need to compare every option at a glance (use filter chips or a select).

alternatives.name: Tabs
alternatives.reason: When there are only a few tabs.

accessibility: Follow the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern, connecting tablist, tab, and tabpanel; ←/→ and Home/End move between tabs.
Keep the selected tab in view with scrollIntoView.
The arrow buttons are a mouse aid, so they're left out of the Tab order.
Mark the selected tab with weight and an underline.
